cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The Code du numérique gives the authority the duty to authorise or refuse cross-border transfers, and no route without it is named [COD-001]. That answers question 1 yes and question 2 closed, so the stage is 2.
